Title: Free course on the Log Analytics query language (KQL) now available

Body.Content:
Some of the most commonly asked questions we get in Azure Log Analytics and Application Insights are around the query language. These come both from beginners who need a hand getting started, and intermediate users who want to know what advanced capabilities are available to them.

To answer these questions and more, we’ve paired up with Pluralsight to design and provide you a course on KQL. It will teach you topics such as:

  • Zero to 80% of the operators you’ll ever use in under an hour
  • Advanced aggregations
  • Working with time series and machine learning

The course is free. Simply visit the Pluralsight course webpage to register and get started.
